gloss: to sleep soundly; to sleep deeply

definitions.gloss: to sleep soundly; to sleep deeply
definitions.explanation: To fall into a deep, uninterrupted, restful sleep. Implies high quality of sleep with no disturbances.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|ゆうべ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熟睡|じゅくすい}→熟睡：11079_jukusui⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to sleep soundly last night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{熟睡|じゅくすい}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧にして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The baby is sleeping soundly, so please be quiet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧{熟睡|じゅくすい}できること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: On days when I exercise, I'm often tired enough to sleep deeply.

notes:
Describes the ideal quality of sleep — deep and undisturbed. Commonly appears in health and lifestyle discussions about sleep quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熟睡|じゅくすい}できる: to be able to sleep soundly
- {熟睡|じゅくすい}できない: unable to sleep deeply
- ⟦{熟睡|じゅくすい}→熟睡：11079_jukusui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧: tips for sleeping soundly
- ⟦{熟睡|じゅくすい}→熟睡：11079_jukusui⟧⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧: feeling of having slept deeply

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぐっすり→ぐっすり：02676_gussuri⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧: to sleep soundly (colloquial) — more casual and conversational, while ⟦{熟睡|じゅくすい}→熟睡：11079_jukusui⟧ is more formal and often used in written or medical contexts
- ⟦{爆睡|ばくすい}→爆睡：15296_bakusui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to crash out, to sleep like a log (informal) — emphasizes falling asleep suddenly and completely, often from exhaustion, with a more casual or humorous tone
- ⟦{安眠|あんみん}→安眠：12266_anmin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sleep peacefully — emphasizes tranquility of sleep rather than depth
